capture_method: Untouched native XCTest XCUIScreen screenshot of an external simulator harness directly displaying the existing production BrewView. No screenshot editing, compositing or chart drawing in harness.
data_source: Actual user-authorized Bookoo Themis journal recording, original 279 weight/time samples and original dose/duration.
genuine_record_difference: The last two original raw samples are46.2g; saved final_weight and native filtered weight-chart endpoint are46.1g. Normal production pause freezes the latest raw scale value46.2g. This difference was preserved; neither measurements nor metadata were changed to force matching digits.

harness_boundary.wrapper: Separate local.beanzen.mainflowcapture simulator application built only under /private/tmp; @testable imports existing Debug BeanZen.framework. It is a capture wrapper, not a production app release or physical BLE session.
injected_state: Original recorded weights and measurement timestamps supplied to BluetoothManager
StopWatch elapsed/state driven by original recording timestamps instead of a real-time timer
GaggiMate mode keys absent; channels nil
production_calls: FlowMeter.add(weight:at:) and tick(at:) for normal instantaneous header flow
BrewSession.onWeightTick() once for each original sample
BrewSession.onFlowTick() at production1-second cadence using current original sample
BrewSession.pause(fromScale:true) for native normal-scale paused controls
forbidden_changes_not_made: No assignments to weightData or flowrateData
No custom chart points or fabricated flow values
No modifications to production source, binary, view layout, fonts or chart algorithms
additional_wrapper_differences: Main ContentView app-root timer subscriptions are replaced by a deterministic recorded-time driver calling the same production session methods.
Navigation callbacks are no-ops in the screenshot-only external wrapper.
Light color scheme chosen from the supported production presentation; production BrewView and all chart/metric/control views are unchanged.

publication_description: Ordinary scale-mode main screen, replaying an actual recorded brew through unchanged production views and algorithms in an isolated native capture harness. Do not describe as physical live Bluetooth brewing.
